plurals.item: It will lock itself again in %d minute.

resources.string: Could not download from %1$s: %2$s
%1$s was installed.
This device could not be locked to its apps, so the person using it can still leave them. Set the device up again from the trainer\'s phone.
This app could not be made the home screen, so the device will start somewhere else. Set the device up again from the trainer\'s phone.
Some settings on this device are not protected, so they can still be changed by the person using it. Set the device up again from the trainer\'s phone.
Location and automatic time could not be turned on. Turn both on by hand in the device settings before handing the device over.
The screen timeout and lock screen could not be set. Set the screen timeout by hand in the device settings.
The apps on this device are not protected from being uninstalled. Re-apply the lock settings from the admin screen once the apps have finished installing.
%1$s can still be uninstalled by the person using the device. Re-apply the lock settings from the admin screen.
The apps could not be given their permissions in advance, so each app will ask for them the first time. Open every app once and allow what it asks for.
The Wi-Fi networks for this deployment could not be added. Add them by hand on the Wi-Fi page of the admin screen.
The Wi-Fi network %1$s could not be added. Add it by hand on the Wi-Fi page of the admin screen.
Wi-Fi and mobile network settings are not locked down, so the person using the device can still change them. Re-apply the lock settings from the admin screen.
The home screen could not be released, so this app may still start instead of the normal one. Erase the device to clear it.
The lock on the apps could not be removed. Erase the device to clear it.
Some settings are still protected and cannot be changed. Erase the device to clear them.
Some apps still cannot be uninstalled. Erase the device to clear that.
The lock screen and app permission settings were left as they were. Change them by hand in the device settings.
This app is still in charge of the device. Erase the device to remove it.
